recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見中至大型母細胞樣細胞，核不規則或呈腎形、染色質細緻，胞質灰藍色且無顆粒，部分有類似偽足的突出；組織中為單調的母細胞樣浸潤，TCL1 與 TCF4 強陽性，皮膚切片則為真皮至皮下的密集浸潤而表皮不受累，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）的白血病型表現。
features: Medium to large blastoid cells with irregular, reniform or indented nuclei and fine chromatin (A)
Moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, occasionally with tail-like or pseudopod projections (A)
Diffuse monomorphous infiltrate of blastoid cells in tissue (B)
Strong diffuse TCL1 (cytoplasmic/nuclear) and nuclear TCF4 immunostaining (C)
Skin biopsy: dense dermal and subcutaneous infiltrate with sparing of the epidermis; inset shows blastoid cells (D)
describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear contains medium to large blastoid cells with irregular to reniform nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic projections (A). A tissue section shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of similar blastoid cells (B), which are strongly positive for TCL1 and TCF4 (C). A skin biopsy shows a dense infiltrate filling the dermis and extending into subcutaneous fat, with sparing of the epidermis (D). Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm presenting in a leukemic phase; confirmation of CD123, CD4 and CD56 expression with absence of lineage-specific myeloid, T- and B-cell markers is required.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (leukemia cutis)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML may involve skin with folded nuclei but is usually lysozyme/CD14/CD11c-positive and lacks coexpression of TCF4 and TCL1 with bright CD123.

ddx.dx: AML with mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation
ddx.vs: In this entity the pDC are mature-appearing and accompany a separate myeloid blast population, usually with RUNX1 mutation, rather than forming the neoplastic blast population.
T-lymphoblasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT with scant cytoplasm, whereas BPDCN cells lack CD3 and have more abundant gray cytoplasm.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56-positive but EBER-positive with angiocentric necrosis and cytotoxic granules, and is CD123- and TCF4-negative.
